16void ACombatPlayerController::BeginPlay()
17{
18 Super::BeginPlay();
19
20 // only spawn touch controls on local player controllers
21 if (SVirtualJoystick::ShouldDisplayTouchInterface() && IsLocalPlayerController())
22 {
23 // spawn the mobile controls widget
24 MobileControlsWidget = CreateWidget<UUserWidget>(this, MobileControlsWidgetClass);
25
26 if (MobileControlsWidget)
27 {
28 // add the controls to the player screen
29 MobileControlsWidget->AddToPlayerScreen(0);
30
31 } else {
32
33 UE_LOG(LogAudioRADAR, Error, TEXT("Could not spawn mobile controls widget."));
34
35 }
36
37 }
38}

40void ACombatPlayerController::SetupInputComponent()
41{
42 // only add IMCs for local player controllers
43 if (IsLocalPlayerController())
44 {
45 // add the input mapping context
46 if (UEnhancedInputLocalPlayerSubsystem* Subsystem = ULocalPlayer::GetSubsystem<UEnhancedInputLocalPlayerSubsystem>(GetLocalPlayer()))
47 {
48 for (UInputMappingContext* CurrentContext : DefaultMappingContexts)
49 {
50 Subsystem->AddMappingContext(CurrentContext, 0);
51 }
52
53 // only add these IMCs if we're not using mobile touch input
54 if (!SVirtualJoystick::ShouldDisplayTouchInterface())
55 {
56 for (UInputMappingContext* CurrentContext : MobileExcludedMappingContexts)
57 {
58 Subsystem->AddMappingContext(CurrentContext, 0);
59 }
60 }
61 }
62 }
63}

65void ACombatPlayerController::OnPossess(APawn* InPawn)
